correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and 1<=s<=n, the face-balanced probability mixture has covariance contrast eigenvalue lambda=(2n-s-1)/[n(n-1)(s+1)]>0, so its affine reproducing kernel is K(t,u)=1+nB(sum_i t_i u_i-1/n), B=(n-1)(s+1)/(2n-s-1). Convexity of F(t)=E|K(t,T)| reduces the endpoint norm to a simplex vertex, where T_1 is 0 with probability 1-s/n and otherwise Beta(1,s-1). Integrating min(T_1,nu), nu=(s-1)/[(n-1)(s+1)], gives exact sharp symmetric L^1/L^infty norm 2B(1-nu)^s-1; s=1 is identity, s=n agrees with known volume formula. At fixed s, B->(s+1)/2 and norm->s; at s/n->alpha, the ratio norm/n->2alpha exp(-alpha)/(2-alpha). Independently recomputed rational covariance, endpoints and positivity for every n=3..39, 1<=s<=n; not a proof of the infinite ranges.
